newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Momentum rises to new high on solid results.
newsitem.headline: Momentum rises to new high on solid results.

text.p: Strong growth in year earnings propelled shares in South Africa's Momentum Life Assurers Ltd to their best level ever on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on Monday, dealers said.
In the morning session shares climbed 180 cents or 5.1 percent to a new high of 36.80 rand. By 1145 GMT shares had edged off their peaks to trade at 36.60 after 15,300 shares had changed hands.

Momentum on Monday reported a 42 percent rise in headline earnings to 103.4 cents a share in the year to June 30 from 72.8 cents a year ago. The dividend was increased to 57 cents a share from 40.5 cents before.
"It was a set of excellent results," an equity dealer said.

"It also looks like they experienced growth in sustainable areas," he said adding that the group's asset management business, which increased assets to 30.9 billion from 19.8 billion last year, was the star performer.
In its results announcement Momentum said the strategic changes it had made over the last few years would continue to have a positive impact on the group's results in the medium term.
